results.title: Saudi Arabia World Cup 2026 Squad — 26-man Roster, Predicted XI & Key Players | Match Later
highlights:
Saudi Arabia World Cup 2026 Squad — 26-man Roster, Predicted XI & Key Players | Match Later
[...]
# Saudi Arabia World Cup 26-man squad
[...]
4-2-3-1
[...]
Georgios Donis's (Greek) Saudi Arabia announced their final 26 on May 31 (trimmed from 30). This is Saudi's third consecutive World Cup (7th overall) — and a milestone tournament for the 2034 World Cup hosts. The 2022 Argentina upset still echoes through the squad.
[...]
Spine: captain Salem Al-Dawsari (Al-Hilal, the 2022 Argentina-winning goalscorer) + Firas Al-Buraikan (Al-Ahli) + Mohamed Kanno (Al-Hilal, 75 caps). A Saudi Pro League-heavy squad with only Saud Abdulhamid (Lens) currently playing in Europe.
[...]
94 USA Round of 16 berth
[...]

[...]
## LIKELY 4-2-3-1.
[...]
Donis's preferred 4-2-3-1. Al-Buraikan (Al-Ahli) at No.9, captain Al-Dawsari (the 2022 Argentina hero) left, Yahya right. Kanno + Al-Khaibari as the double pivot. Al-Tambakti + Al-Amri at CB. Abdulhamid (Lens) and Boushal at full-back.
